FAQ

Common questions.
Clear answers.

Can I enquire as a new patient?

Use the demonstration enquiry form below to explore the process. It does not send an appointment request.

What if I feel anxious about treatment?

Discuss your concerns with a qualified dental professional. Comfort options and suitability depend on your individual circumstances.

How often should I have a checkup?

A dental professional can recommend an interval based on your oral health and individual needs.

How are fees and payment options agreed?

Ask the clinic for an individual quotation and any available payment terms before proceeding. The displayed fees are illustrative.

What should I do in an emergency?

Contact a local urgent dental service for dental pain or trauma. Severe swelling, difficulty breathing or uncontrolled bleeding requires urgent medical help.

Can I enquire about care for my child?

Yes. Discuss age-appropriate dental care and consent with your chosen clinic.

How long does a visit take?

Timing varies by assessment and treatment. Confirm the expected duration with the clinic.
